g.text: Farm data remain the basis for local validation—not a one-time input to a generic model.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 25px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #1e2b2a

g.text: Start small. Add data when it changes a decision

text.style: font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4f5c59

g.text: A staged pilot reduces burden while making the value of each dataset visible.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: end; fill: #ffffff

g.text: Recommended pilot structure. Scope and governance should be agreed before data transfer.
